name: SST Reading Nonverbal Cues
summary:
1. Select ""Start Experience."
2. Make eye contact with the other person and greet them with your hand.
3. Understand the other person's nonverbal communication and select the appropriate Emotion Robot.
4. Raise your hand or nod your head according to the other person's response.
5. Select the response card that best fits the flow of the conversation.
